summary: GSK plc files a Form 6-K reporting a routine director/PDMR shareholding transaction. President US, Maya Martinez-Davis, acquired 9.4289 notional ADS at $50.64 in her Executive Supplemental Savings Plan account. There is no corporate action, merger, tender, or strategic event. The filing is a standard insider transaction notification under UK rules, furnished as a foreign private issuer report. No deal terms, premium, or board recommendation are present. This is not a special situation.
